title: Z
short_synopsis: A magistrate investigates the assassination of a political activist.
long_synopsis: After the killing of a prominent political figure, an investigation reveals the role of powerful institutions in orchestrating and covering up political violence.
political_relevance: The film examines state repression, institutional cover-ups, and the mechanics of authoritarian power.
review_excerpt: A blistering political thriller with procedural intensity and moral urgency.

title: The Lives of Others
short_synopsis: An East German secret police officer surveils an artist.
long_synopsis: Set in East Berlin, the film explores the moral corrosion of surveillance states and the fragile resistance of intellectual life under authoritarian rule.
political_relevance: The film is a powerful study of surveillance, censorship, and the human cost of totalitarian bureaucracy.
review_excerpt: Measured, intelligent, and emotionally devastating.

title: Sorry We Missed You
short_synopsis: A family is pushed to the brink by precarious gig-economy labor.
long_synopsis: Ken Loach portrays the crushing structural pressures of insecure work and economic survival in contemporary Britain.
political_relevance: The film critiques labor precarity and the erosion of dignity under modern capitalism.
review_excerpt: A devastating social drama that turns everyday labor into political tragedy.

title: The Battle of Algiers
short_synopsis: The Algerian struggle for independence from French colonial rule.
long_synopsis: A realistic depiction of the FLN's guerrilla warfare and the brutal methods of French paratroopers during the Algerian War.
political_relevance: A foundational film for understanding urban insurgency and anticolonial struggle.
review_excerpt: One of the most influential political films ever made.

title: Parasite
short_synopsis: A poor family schemes to work for a wealthy household.
long_synopsis: The Kim family infiltrates the Park household, leading to a violent collision of class interests.
political_relevance: A sharp critique of modern class stratification and capitalist disparity.
review_excerpt: A genre-bending masterpiece on global inequality.

title: I, Daniel Blake
short_synopsis: A carpenter fights the dehumanizing welfare system.
long_synopsis: After a heart attack, Daniel Blake is denied state benefits and struggles against the bureaucratic machine.
political_relevance: An indictment of austerity and the erosion of the social safety net.
review_excerpt: Quietly devastating and deeply human.

title: All the President's Men
short_synopsis: Two reporters investigate the Watergate scandal.
long_synopsis: Journalists Woodward and Bernstein uncover a web of government corruption leading to the Nixon resignation.
political_relevance: The definitive film about the power of the press and political accountability.
review_excerpt: A masterclass in procedural tension.

title: La Haine
short_synopsis: Three young men navigate a violent Paris suburb after a riot.
long_synopsis: Following a police beating, three friends spend 24 hours in the projects, reflecting the cycle of hatred and police brutality.
political_relevance: A prophetic look at social marginalization in modern France.
review_excerpt: Taut, stylish, and socially explosive.

title: Missing
short_synopsis: A father searches for his son during the 1973 Chilean coup.
long_synopsis: An American businessman searches for his journalist son, discovering U.S. complicity in the military takeover.
political_relevance: Exposes the dark side of Cold War foreign policy and state-sponsored disappearances.
review_excerpt: A chilling and precise political indictment.

title: The Great Dictator
short_synopsis: A Jewish barber is mistaken for a fascist dictator.
long_synopsis: Chaplin satirizes Hitler and the Nazi regime, culminating in a world-famous plea for humanism and peace.
political_relevance: A courageous anti-fascist statement released during the height of the Nazi threat.
review_excerpt: A timeless masterpiece of humanism.

title: Quo Vadis, Aida?
short_synopsis: A UN translator tries to save her family during the Srebrenica massacre.
long_synopsis: Aida, a translator for the UN, struggles to navigate the bureaucracy and the advancing Serbian army to protect her husband and sons.
political_relevance: A harrowing examination of genocide and the failure of international institutions.
review_excerpt: A gut-punch of a film that demands to be seen.

title: Do the Right Thing
short_synopsis: Racial tensions explode in a Brooklyn neighborhood.
long_synopsis: On the hottest day of the year, racial micro-aggressions in a local community lead to a tragic police confrontation.
political_relevance: A landmark exploration of systemic racism and civil disobedience in America.
review_excerpt: A masterpiece of color, sound, and social fury.

title: The Conversation
short_synopsis: A surveillance expert uncovers a potential murder.
long_synopsis: A lonely surveillance professional realizes that his latest recording might lead to the death of his targets.
political_relevance: Reflects the post-Watergate era's paranoia regarding private and state surveillance.
review_excerpt: A chilling masterpiece of technical and psychological precision.

title: No
short_synopsis: An ad executive fights to end Pinochet's dictatorship.
long_synopsis: The story of the marketing campaign that led to the defeat of General Pinochet in the 1988 Chilean referendum.
political_relevance: Explores how marketing and media were used to restore democracy.
review_excerpt: Smart, original, and historically fascinating.

title: Children of Men
short_synopsis: In a world of infertility, a man must protect a pregnant refugee.
long_synopsis: A dystopian vision of a world where humanity has lost the ability to procreate, focusing on the treatment of refugees and state collapse.
political_relevance: A powerful commentary on xenophobia and modern border politics.
review_excerpt: A technical marvel with a profound social message.

title: The Trial of the Chicago 7
short_synopsis: A group of protesters face trial after the 1968 convention.
long_synopsis: The legal battle following the anti-Vietnam war protests in Chicago, highlighting the clash between youth movements and the state.
political_relevance: Examines the right to dissent and the weaponization of the judicial system.
review_excerpt: A sharp, energetic look at political justice.

title: Judas and the Black Messiah
short_synopsis: The betrayal of Black Panther leader Fred Hampton.
long_synopsis: An FBI informant infiltrates the Black Panther Party, leading to the assassination of deputy chairman Fred Hampton.
political_relevance: A critique of state surveillance and the suppression of radical social movements.
review_excerpt: Electrifying and profoundly relevant.

title: State of Siege
short_synopsis: A USAID official is kidnapped in Uruguay.
long_synopsis: The investigation into a kidnapping reveals the hidden role of the US in training Latin American police in torture.
political_relevance: A stark look at Cold War interventionism and urban guerrilla ethics.
review_excerpt: A provocative and uncompromising political statement.

title: Persépolis
short_synopsis: A young girl grows up during the Iranian Revolution.
long_synopsis: An animated biography detailing the shift from monarchy to Islamic fundamentalism and the struggle for personal freedom.
political_relevance: Provides a personal perspective on theocratic rule and exile.
review_excerpt: Brilliant, moving, and visually unique.

title: Dr. Strangelove
short_synopsis: An insane general triggers a nuclear apocalypse.
long_synopsis: A biting satire of the Cold War and the absurdity of the nuclear arms race and military bureaucracy.
political_relevance: The ultimate critique of the madness behind the concept of Mutual Assured Destruction.
review_excerpt: Terrifyingly funny and still incredibly relevant.

title: Capernaum
short_synopsis: A boy sues his parents for giving him life.
long_synopsis: In the slums of Beirut, a young boy survives on the streets and eventually takes legal action against his parents for their neglect.
political_relevance: A heart-wrenching look at the plight of undocumented children and extreme poverty.
review_excerpt: Emotional, powerful, and deeply necessary.

title: Waltz with Bashir
short_synopsis: An animated search for lost memories of the Lebanon War.
long_synopsis: A filmmaker reconstructs his experiences during the 1982 invasion of Lebanon and the Sabra and Shatila massacre.
political_relevance: Explores collective guilt and the trauma of war through a revolutionary format.
review_excerpt: A haunting and visionary documentary.

title: Land and Freedom
short_synopsis: An idealist fights in the Spanish Civil War.
long_synopsis: A British communist joins the POUM militia in Spain, only to witness the internal betrayal of the revolution by Stalinist forces.
political_relevance: A profound look at ideological purity versus political pragmatism.
review_excerpt: A moving and intellectually honest look at a forgotten struggle.

title: The Official Story
short_synopsis: A mother discovers her adopted child was taken from political prisoners.
long_synopsis: During the end of Argentina's military dictatorship, a woman suspects her daughter was 'stolen' from 'disappeared' parents.
political_relevance: Examines the legacy of the 'Dirty War' and personal complicity in state crimes.
review_excerpt: A powerful reckoning with national trauma.

title: If....
short_synopsis: Students at a boarding school stage a violent revolt.
long_synopsis: A surreal satire of the British education system and class hierarchy, where repressed students turn to armed rebellion.
political_relevance: Captures the spirit of the 1968 counter-culture and anti-establishment movements.
review_excerpt: A wild, anarchic masterpiece.

title: The Killing Fields
short_synopsis: A journalist is trapped during the Khmer Rouge takeover.
long_synopsis: A portrayal of the Cambodian genocide through the eyes of an American reporter and his local assistant.
political_relevance: A stark look at the horrors of the Khmer Rouge regime and the human cost of war.
review_excerpt: Unflinching and deeply moving.

title: Roma
short_synopsis: The life of a domestic worker during political unrest in Mexico.
long_synopsis: A domestic worker in Mexico City navigates personal tragedy and the Corpus Christi massacre of students.
political_relevance: Explores the intersection of indigenous identity, labor, and state violence.
review_excerpt: Visually stunning and deeply personal.

title: A Hidden Life
short_synopsis: An Austrian farmer refuses to fight for the Nazis.
long_synopsis: The true story of Franz Jägerstätter, a conscientious objector who faced execution for refusing to swear loyalty to Hitler.
political_relevance: Examines moral courage and individual resistance against a totalitarian state.
review_excerpt: A breathtaking testament to faith and defiance.

title: Bread and Roses
short_synopsis: Undocumented cleaners in LA fight for a union.
long_synopsis: Two sisters working in the shadows of the LA service industry join a strike for 'justice for janitors'.
political_relevance: Focuses on the invisibility of service workers and the power of collective labor.
review_excerpt: Compassionate and fiercely political.

title: Man of Marble
short_synopsis: A filmmaker uncovers the truth about a former labor hero.
long_synopsis: A student filmmaker investigates the rise and fall of a bricklayer who was used as a tool for socialist propaganda.
political_relevance: Exposes the manipulation of truth and history in a communist state.
review_excerpt: A brave look at the machinery of the state.

title: Selma
short_synopsis: Martin Luther King's march for voting rights.
long_synopsis: The film details the 1965 march from Selma to Montgomery and the political maneuvering behind the Voting Rights Act.
political_relevance: Examines the mechanics of non-violent protest and racial justice.
review_excerpt: A powerful, humanized look at a historical giant.

title: Salò, or the 120 Days of Sodom
short_synopsis: Fascists kidnap teenagers for sadistic rituals.
long_synopsis: An extreme allegory of the dehumanizing nature of absolute power during the last days of Italian fascism.
political_relevance: A controversial critique of fascism and the 'banality of evil'.
review_excerpt: Unbearable for many, but a profound statement.

title: 12 Years a Slave
short_synopsis: A free man is kidnapped and sold into slavery.
long_synopsis: The true story of Solomon Northup, who was kidnapped in Washington D.C. and sold into the brutal slave trade of the American South.
political_relevance: A foundational film for understanding the systemic roots of racism.
review_excerpt: An essential, agonizing piece of history.

title: Burn!
short_synopsis: A British agent incites a slave revolt for economic gain.
long_synopsis: A look at how European powers manipulated anti-colonial struggles in the Caribbean to replace old empires with new capitalist control.
political_relevance: A classic analysis of neocolonialism and global power dynamics.
review_excerpt: A brilliant analysis of the commodification of revolution.

title: V for Vendetta
short_synopsis: A masked rebel fights a fascist future government.
long_synopsis: In a future Britain, a vigilante uses terrorist tactics to inspire a population to rise up against their totalitarian leaders.
political_relevance: Highly influential in modern protest culture and civil disobedience movements.
review_excerpt: Visually arresting with a provocative message.

title: The Wind That Shakes the Barley
short_synopsis: Brothers fight for Irish independence and then civil war.
long_synopsis: The story of the Irish War of Independence and the subsequent civil war that turned former comrades against each other.
political_relevance: Explores the transition from national liberation to ideological conflict.
review_excerpt: Beautifully shot and emotionally shattering.

title: M
short_synopsis: A city hunts a serial killer through police and mobs.
long_synopsis: In Berlin, both the law and the criminal underworld hunt a child killer, reflecting the collapse of social order.
political_relevance: A critique of the failing Weimar Republic and the rise of mob justice.
review_excerpt: A timeless masterpiece of social commentary.

title: Fruitvale Station
short_synopsis: The last day of Oscar Grant, killed by transit police.
long_synopsis: A humanizing look at the final hours of a young man before his tragic death at the hands of Oakland transit police.
political_relevance: A central film in the dialogue about systemic racism and police brutality.
review_excerpt: Heartbreaking and essential.

title: Caché
short_synopsis: A family is terrorized by anonymous surveillance tapes.
long_synopsis: The mystery of who is filming a middle-class family leads back to repressed colonial guilt from the 1961 Paris massacre.
political_relevance: Explores how historical violence and national guilt haunt the present.
review_excerpt: A masterfully uneasy psychological thriller.

title: The Baader Meinhof Complex
short_synopsis: The rise and fall of West German militant groups.
long_synopsis: A depiction of the Red Army Faction (RAF) and their radicalization from students to urban guerrillas in the 1970s.
political_relevance: Examines the limits of political radicalism and the state's response to terrorism.
review_excerpt: A thrilling and provocative historical epic.
